page_title: MNU 3-2 AST | Manchester Utd v Aston Villa 26/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' Craig Pawson is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+9' Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa) brings an opponent down and Craig Pawson interrupts the game.
90+5' Substitution. Alejandro Garnacho leaves the pitch and is replaced by Hannibal Mejbri (Manchester United).
90+4' Here is a change. Christian Eriksen is going off and Erik ten Hag gives the last tactical orders to Daniel Gore (Manchester United).
90+3' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
90' 9 additional min. will be played.
89' We are about to witness a subsitution. Willy Kambwala (Manchester United) for Rasmus Hojlund.
87' Craig Pawson shows a yellow card to Ezri Konsa (Aston Villa) for a tough tackle.
86' The referee allows time for a substitution. John McGinn will be replaced by Jhon Duran (Aston Villa).
86' Unai Emery prepares a substitution. Leander Dendoncker is replaced by Tim Iroegbunam (Aston Villa).

82' 3 - 2 Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) is the first to get to a rebound and his weak but precise effort finds its way through the defenders in the goalmouth and into the back of the net, bouncing in off the left post.
82' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
81' Here's the change. Kobbie Mainoo leaves the pitch and Scott McTominay (Manchester United) comes on as a substitute.
80' Substitution. Marcus Rashford is replaced by Antony (Manchester United).
77' Unai Emery has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa) replacing Leon Bailey.
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) comes onto the pitch for Jacob Ramsey.
77' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
77' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
76' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
76' Craig Pawson blows his whistle and it's Aaron Wan-Bissaka (Manchester United) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
74' Craig Pawson shows the yellow card to Diego Carlos (Aston Villa) for a heavy challenge.
73' The expression of the referee Craig Pawson is crystal clear. This behaviour won't be tolerated. Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is shown a yellow card.
73' John McGinn (Aston Villa) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.

71' 2 - 2 Goal! Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) picks up the ball inside the box, finds himself in a good position and fires in a shot which is deflected past Emiliano Martinez. He makes it 2:2.
70' The ball is cleared after Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
70' The corner kick from Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
69' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball goes out of play. Manchester Utd are awarded a corner kick.
66' Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) is caught offside!
64' Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) tackles a bit over-zealously and Craig Pawson blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Aston Villa, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
63' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) beautifully controls a cross from the wing inside the box, but he fails to test the keeper and sends his shot miles past the left post.
63' Diego Carlos (Aston Villa) is challenged in the air near the penalty spot and is unable to control his header from the corner, sending it miles over the bar.
63' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
62' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear. Aston Villa force a corner. They send men into the box.
61' Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
60' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the middle of the goal. However, Andre Onana anticipates the shot and makes a decent save.

59' 1 - 2 Marcus Rashford produces a sweet pass and picks out Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) inside the box. He quickly takes a shot which goes into the middle of the net and leaves the goalkeeper helpless. He makes it 1:2!
58' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
57' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) unleashed a rocket of a shot aiming towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his attempt with a stunning save.
55' Emiliano Martinez displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
50' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) is being substituted because of an injury. Unai Emery sends Alex Moreno on the pitch.
50' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Manchester Utd due to an offside in the build-up play.
49' The Manchester Utd players halt their celebrations as referee Craig Pawson makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.

48' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) runs on to a clever pass from Marcus Rashford and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He still has work to do but finishes with aplomb into the back of the net.
47' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
47' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Craig Pawson saw the whole situation. Aston Villa earn a free kick.
46' The second half has just started.
45+5' Craig Pawson blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+4' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is flagged for offside.
45+2' Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Craig Pawson ignores the protests.
45+2' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
45' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) gets inside the box and only has the keeper to beat, but lashes his shot well wide of the left post.
43' Ezri Konsa (Aston Villa) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
42' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) tries to find Marcus Rashford, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
42' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
41' Flag goes up against Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
40' Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
39' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) sends a cross into the box, but Emiliano Martinez comes off his line to gather the ball.
38' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
37' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is adjudged offside.
36' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Manchester Utd force their opponents to concede a corner.

36' What a wasted opportunity by Marcus Rashford (Manchester United)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the middle of the net, but Emiliano Martinez makes a comfortable save to thwart him.
35' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the mid-range attempt from the free-kick by Christian Eriksen (Manchester United).
35' It seemed like Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
33' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Craig Pawson blows his whistle for a foul.

32' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) sets himself up and has a crack at goal from the edge of the box. The shot heads low to the middle of the goal, but Emiliano Martinez tracks it all the way and makes an easy save.
31' My Gran could have done better! Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) got himself in a great position on the edge of the box after a pass, but put his shot well wide of the left post.
30' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Craig Pawson blows for a foul.
28' Flag up against Christian Eriksen (Manchester United). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.

26' 0 - 2 A superb goal from great team play! Leander Dendoncker (Aston Villa) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent shot into the middle of the net. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.
26' John McGinn (Aston Villa) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
21' 0 - 1 GOAL! The mid-range free kick from John McGinn (Aston Villa) somehow evades the defence and goalie and finds its way into the back of net! No way he meant that but the score is now 0:1.
21' It seemed like John McGinn (Aston Villa) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
21' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) was too forceful with his tackle and Craig Pawson interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Aston Villa have a free kick.
18' A dangerous looking corner kick from Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) is cleared to safety by the defence.
16' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
16' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) sends a chip pass into the box, but Emiliano Martinez is quickest to intercept the ball.
12' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after John McGinn (Aston Villa) took the corner.
12' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Aston Villa.
11' Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) collects a rebound and produces a mid-range attempt. The ball goes low to the middle of the target, but Emiliano Martinez keeps it out.
9' John McGinn (Aston Villa) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
8' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
6' A lofted cross from Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
4' What a goal-scoring opportunity! John McGinn (Aston Villa) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in.
2' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
1' The first half has just begun.
Manchester Utd will kick the game off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Craig Pawson.
